newsitem.title: USA: Cortex stake cut by Soros group.
newsitem.headline: Cortex stake cut by Soros group.

text.p: A group led by U.S. investor George Soros said Tuesday it lowered its stake in Cortex Pharmaceuticals to 660,000 common shares or 7.5 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 200,500 common shares between January 6 and February 18 at prices ranging from $4.012 to $4.924 per share.
Cortex, based in Irvine, Calif., is engaged in research and development of pharmaceutical compounds, therapeutic drugs and diagnostic products.
